title: Value-Preserving Architectures for Agentic AI Systems
measurement_description: The paper does not conduct empirical measurements or evaluations. Instead, it proposes value-preserving architectural patterns for Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). Religion is mentioned in the context of the 'Plan-Triggered Guard Agents' pattern, which includes a conceptual 'Religion Bias Guard' designed to detect and mitigate bias before an agent executes an action.
findings: The paper does not provide empirical findings. It theoretically proposes a 'Plan-Triggered Guard Agents' architecture that features specialized modular guard agents (including a 'Religion Bias Guard') to intercept, detect, and mitigate social biases at runtime before they contaminate downstream tasks.
